hero.label: FADO Group — Cross‑Border Commerce Ecosystem
hero.sub: From an international shopping platform founded in 2011, FADO Group has grown into an ecosystem of 14+ brands across logistics, technology and retail — operating throughout Vietnam, Australia and 9+ countries worldwide.

about.para1: FADO Group began with FADO.VN in 2011 — a platform helping Vietnamese consumers access authentic products from the US, Japan, Germany and the UK. From a cross-border e-commerce platform, we gradually expanded into logistics, technology and international retail, ensuring every link in the supply chain is owned and operated within our own ecosystem.
about.para2: Today, FADO Group is a diversified conglomerate of independently operating brands that share common technology infrastructure, data and operations — serving individual consumers in Vietnam, young families in Australia, and import-export businesses worldwide.
about.v01Body: A unified warehousing, logistics and technology system running in sync across multiple markets.
about.v02Body: Every member brand is digitised by Woka — a logistics platform built and owned by the Group.
about.v03Body: Each new brand fills a missing link in the shared value chain, strengthening the whole ecosystem.

ecosystem.sub: Each brand within FADO Group solves a specific link in international commerce — from the moment an order is placed to the moment the product reaches the end customer, anywhere in the world.

globalPresence.sub: FADO Group's offices and logistics hubs span from headquarters in Australia, operational centres in Vietnam, to connection points in Europe, North America and East Asia.

contact.sub: Whether you are an investor, logistics partner or talented candidate — we are always looking for people to join our cross-border commerce journey.
